narrative.overview: MyAuthify delivers a high-precision, developer-first aesthetic inspired by modern infrastructure tools. Built around an obsidian dark mode base (#16171d), the visual atmosphere emphasizes crisp typography, high-contrast monospace code blocks, and electric violet accents.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian background with subtle borders and clean structural framing.
Electric violet glow accents for active states, badges, and primary interactive elements.
Monospaced typography for code sandboxes, session tokens, and key prefixes.
High-contrast hierarchy for maximum legibility in developer workflows.

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: The electric violet accent (#c084fc) is reserved for interactive actions, focus rings, and active state indicators. It occupies under 10% of any screen surface.

rules.name: The Layered Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not float arbitrarily; depth is expressed by stacking translucent surface colors with explicit 1px border framing (#2e303a).

dos: Do use monospaced typography (ui-monospace) for all API keys, session tokens, and code snippets.
Do keep borders crisp and 1px wide using #2e303a for clear structural division.
Do reserve the violet accent (#c084fc) for interactive actions and status highlights.
donts: Don't use heavy drop shadows or bright colored backgrounds for non-interactive cards.
Don't mix multiple accent colors on the same view; keep the palette unified around obsidian & violet.
Don't override monospaced font formatting on API tokens or code previews.
